title: Late-Arrival Basis by Funding of the Appointment Series — Worked Sheet
content:
Patient Accounts worked sheet on the late-arrival basis of an Appointment Series late-arrival fee.

**Rule.** The late-arrival basis follows the funding of the series: where the series is funded by a Self-Pay Visit Package whose package tier lists a single-visit cash rate above zero, the basis is 50 percent of that single-visit cash rate; where the series is funded by an Insured Plan of Care whose verified copay is above zero, the basis is the lesser of the late-cancellation fee of the series' format and that copay; for any other series the basis is the late-cancellation fee of the series' format.

**Records read.** The funding source on the series record; the single-visit cash rate of the funding Self-Pay Visit Package's tier; the verified copay of the funding Insured Plan of Care.

**Worked lines (hypothetical figures; format late-cancellation fee USD 45.00).**

| Line | Funding and record figure | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| A | Self-Pay Visit Package, tier cash rate USD 125.00 | 50 percent of USD 125.00, that is USD 62.50 |
| B | Insured Plan of Care, verified copay USD 25.00 | lesser of USD 45.00 and USD 25.00, that is USD 25.00 |
| C | Insured Plan of Care, verified copay USD 50.00 | lesser of USD 45.00 and USD 50.00, that is USD 45.00 |
| D | Workers' Compensation Referral | USD 45.00 |
